CustomField.description: True for the curated "most common support cases" seeded from the S-Docs case sheet. These docs are eligible for the retrieval priority layer (gate-then-weight) so a genuine match surfaces first. Priority NEVER pins blindly: the doc must still clear the semantic/lexical gate at query time. Set by SDocsCaseIngestionService; false for the help.sdocs doc corpus.
